name: Shell points a package manager at a registry that is not public
description: A shell script in this text points a package manager (npm, pnpm, yarn or pip) at a registry that is not one of the public ones, with a config-set command or by writing its config file, so the installs that use that setting come from that host. A project mirror looks the same as a hijack, so this is a finding for judgment, not proof of intent.
